nigeria_note: CBN selling rates are the latest available benchmarks dated 18 Nov. Nigeria parallel ranges combine three independent same-day observations reported at 04:33, 11:37 and 12:00 WAT and rechecked at 13:28 WAT. The published extrema preserve cross-source and location dispersion rather than force a single quote. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1.
